findings.mechanism: functools.lru_cache on a method keeps a class-level cache keyed by (self, account, month), pinning the builder and cached tuples
findings.evidence: Replayed 6x3000 requests with tracemalloc after gc: cache_info shows currsize=128 (maxsize=128), and traced memory stays flat at ~147KB (only a few hundred bytes of jitter per round, no trend). Only one ReportBuilder exists per service.
findings.discriminator: The cache is bounded at 128 entries (currsize pinned at 128 after 14400 misses) and traced heap plateaus; the cached values are small tuples of ints/strs.

findings.mechanism: _columns lists on the long-lived builder hold per-request strings
findings.evidence: render() calls column.clear() on every list at the start of each request, so they hold at most one report's rows (28 rows); heap stayed flat across 18000 requests.
findings.discriminator: Lists are cleared at the top of every render, so size is bounded by one request's rows and does not accumulate.
